description: This file defines a module for theming chart components, including functions to retrieve CSS variable values, convert hex colors to RGBA with alpha, and generate a theme configuration object incorporating CSS variables or fallback theme tokens.

methods.name: getCssVar(name, fallback)
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from the :root element, returning a fallback if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha(hex, alpha, fallbackColor = "rgba(255,102,0,0.4)")
methods.description: Converts a hex color code to an rgba string with specified alpha transparency, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme()
methods.description: Generates and returns a chart theme object with colors sourced from CSS variables or fallback theme tokens, including variants for hover and active states.
